title: FloofyCrew mod manifest (floofy.json, schema 1)
description: The manifest at the root of every FloofyCrew mod (Requirement 1). Identity, host compatibility, graded dependencies, load order, network declaration, contribution parts and the shipped-file list. Keys starting with 'x-' are reserved for extensions and ignored by the framework.

schema.description: Manifest schema version. Requirement 1.1: an integer, first value 1.

id.description: Stable mod identifier used in dependency maps, the registry and the data home. Requirement 1.2.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the manager and the registry. Requirement 1.2.

authors.description: Authors or maintainers, at least one. Requirement 1.2.

license.description: Licence identifier (an SPDX expression is recommended) or a relative path to a licence file. Requirement 1.2.

links.description: Optional named links (homepage, source, issues, ...) as URL strings. Requirement 1.2.

icon.description: Optional relative path to an icon shipped with the mod (also listed in files[]). Requirement 1.2.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for registry search. Requirement 1.2.

kirocrew.description: Host compatibility. Requirement 1.3: 'version' is a SemVer range matched against the host's X.Y.Z base version; 'editions' and 'channels' narrow further; 'strict' turns an out-of-range host from a warning into the non-load reason Unsupported.

dependsOn.description: Hard dependencies (Requirement 1.4). Must include 'floofycrew': the framework version, not the host version, is the hard dependency. A missing or out-of-range entry gives the non-load reason Dependency.

recommends.description: Soft dependencies (Requirement 1.4): a missing entry is a warning, never a non-load reason.

conflicts.description: Mods this mod cannot run alongside (Requirement 1.4). Conflicts are mutual (Requirement 1.5): when both are active the declaring mod is disabled with reason Conflict.

breaks.description: Mods (in range) that this mod is known to break (Requirement 1.4). One-directional: the declaring mod is disabled with reason Conflict while the other stays active.

loadBefore.description: Ids this mod must be activated before (Requirement 1.5). Unknown ids are ignored.

loadAfter.description: Ids this mod must be activated after (Requirement 1.5). Unknown ids are ignored.

network.description: Network declaration (Requirement 1.10, 11.6). Every remote host the mod contacts, and whether the mod asks the user for credentials itself. Plaintext is only allowed to loopback.

parts.description: Contribution parts (Requirement 1.6, 1.7, Requirement 2). Each part names its kind, the side it lands on and a path relative to the mod root, plus kind-specific fields.

files.description: Every file shipped with the mod other than floofy.json itself, with its SHA-256 (Requirement 1.6). A missing or mismatched file gives the non-load reason MissingFiles.

modId.description: Requirement 1.2: lower-case, starts with a letter, 2-64 characters of [a-z0-9_-].

semverRange.description: A version range in the npm style: comparators (>= > < <= =), hyphen ranges (1.2.3 - 2.0.0), caret (^1.2), tilde (~1.2.3), wildcards (1.x, *), unions with ||, whitespace as AND. Fully parsed by floofy validate; the pattern only bounds the character set.

dependencyMap.description: id -> range, or id -> {range, reason}. Requirement 1.4.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the mod root: no leading '/', no '..' segment, no backslashes or control characters (Requirement 1.6, 1.8).

hostPattern.description: A DNS name, optionally with a port, where a label may be '*' to match one or more labels at that position (Requirement 1.10). Examples: api.example.com, *.example.com, api.example.com:8443.

side.description: Where the part lands (Requirement 1.6): the gateway process, the dashboard SPA, the Electron shell or the CLI.

partTheme.description: Requirement 1.7, 2.1: a KiroCrew theme pack. 'path' points at the pack's theme.json; the pack directory is its parent.

partAgent.description: Requirement 1.7, 2.2: an agent spec file (JSON or markdown) installed into the host's agents directory.

partSkill.description: Requirement 1.7, 2.2: a skill. 'path' points at the skill's SKILL.md; the skill directory is its parent.

partAppearance.description: Requirement 1.7, 2.2: an appearance pack. 'path' points at the pack's manifest file; the pack directory is its parent.

partConfig.description: Requirement 2.2: host config.json key/value pairs applied with 'kirocrew config set' semantics; previous values are recorded for uninstall. Pairs come from 'values' (inline), from 'path' (a JSON object file), or both ('values' wins). The only kind whose 'path' is optional.

partApp.description: Requirement 1.7, 2.3: a KiroCrew App installed through the host App Kit. 'path' points at the app's app.json; the app directory is its parent.

partPythonHook.description: Requirement 2.4, Requirement 3: a Python module activated by the Loader inside the gateway process, exposing activate(ctx) / deactivate(ctx). 'path' is the module file or package directory; 'module' the dotted name the Loader imports under its namespaced sys.modules key. 'early' asks for activation through the optional early shim.

partSpa.description: Requirement 2.5, Requirement 4: an ES module loaded by the SPA host inside an error boundary. 'activation' runtime (default) loads after the host bundle through the Loader app's ui entry; 'boot' is injected into index.html by the Patcher for first-frame effects, described by the optional 'boot' object (Requirement 4.3).

bootActivation.description: First-frame effects the Patcher bakes into every payload's index.html for a spa part with activation 'boot' (Requirement 4.3, design 'boot script'): baked CSS placed before </head>, favicon / logo / title asserted before the host hydrates, attributes re-asserted on <html> until the host settles. 'when.theme' gates favicon, logo, title and attributes on the active colour theme (localStorage 'mc-color-theme', else the host config's dashboard.theme_color captured at patch time); the CSS is always baked and must scope itself.

css.description: Relative path to the baked stylesheet (also listed in files[]).

favicon.description: Relative path to an icon (png, svg, jpg, webp, gif) served from the Loader app's ui/boot/<id>/ and set as <link rel=icon> at boot.

logo.description: Relative path to a logo image served the same way and set as the host's --theme-logo custom property at boot.

attributes.description: Attributes asserted on <html> at boot and re-asserted by the drift guard until the host settles (data-* names only).

when.description: Only act when the active colour theme equals 'theme' (for example custom-<slug>); the CSS is baked regardless.

partUi.description: Requirement 16.4: the mod's own page inside the FloofyCrew App. 'path' is the directory holding the page's files (or the entry file itself); 'entry' the ES module the App imports same-origin and mounts through its default export mount(container, api) with api = floofy.mod(id); 'title' the entry in the App's Mods section; 'icon' an optional image. Inert until the user opens it, so it never lands a mod disabled on its own.

partPatch.description: Requirement 2.6, Requirement 5: an overlay patch descriptor (see patch-1.json) applied by the Patcher; the only kind that modifies payload files.
